sources.title: Viego Build Guide: 🔸Viego / Rise of the Ruination🔸

passive.name: Sovereign's Domination
passive.text: Enemies who fall before Viego become wraiths. By attacking a wraith, Viego temporarily seizes control of the dead enemy's body, healing for a percentage of his target's max health and gaining access to their basic abilities and items. He replaces their Ultimate with a free cast of his own.

spells.name: Blade of the Ruined King
spells.text: Viego's spectral blade passively deals bonus percent current Health damage On-Hit and strikes twice vs. enemies he recently hit with an Ability, stealing Health.Viego can activate this Ability to thrust his zweihander forward, impaling enemies in front of him.

spells.name: Spectral Maw
spells.text: Viego charges up before dashing forward, releasing a ball of concentrated Black Mist that stuns the first enemy hit.

spells.name: Harrowed Path
spells.text: Viego commands the Black Mist to haunt and surround a piece of terrain. Viego can hide in the Mist as a wraith, gaining camouflage, Move Speed, and Attack Speed.

spells.name: Heartbreaker
spells.text: Viego teleports to a nearby location and executes an enemy champion on arrival, piercing their heart and causing a destructive shockwave around them that knocks away their allies.

damage.value: Viego deals sustained damage by weaving abilities between auto attacks, then finishes with an execute.

archetype.value: Viego is an aggressive carry jungler who snowballs through skirmishes and possession resets.

axis.value: Viego plays jungle around duels, ganks, and skirmishes rather than lane trades.

winCondition.value: Viego wins by converting picks into objectives and chaining possessions in teamfights.

spikes.why: Viego can turn a single pick into a decisive teamfight.

spikes.at: Harrowed Path's cooldown falls from 14 to 6 seconds
spikes.why: Viego can gain camouflage, Move Speed, and Attack Speed more often.

bait.why: When Viego spends Spectral Maw, its eight-second cooldown leaves enemies a window without its dash and stun.

mistakes.value: Viego loses damage and sustain when he fails to weave abilities between auto attacks.
